comment: The documentation site has no page of controls for Vraids, and the hardware product page says only that the firmware is based on the code by Emilie Gillet. The panel names and the maker's tooltips are the sources for every line here. The model names are SAW-SQR, SIN-TRI, SQR-SUB, SAW-SUB, 3X-SAW, 3X-SQR, 3X-TRI, 3X-SIN, 3X-RING, VOSIM, FEED-FM, PLUCK, BOWED, WAV-TBL, WAV-MAP, WAV-LIN, WAV-TX4 and CLOUD. What the AM/FM knob modulates is stated only by the panel label and the screen legend AM(VCA)/FM, so its line does not say which oscillator modulates which.
